title: PxCorpus: A Spoken Drug Prescription Dataset in French
manual_evidence: Record states automatic transcriptions were human-verified; 2067 recordings are described as manually transcribed and semantically annotated. Dialogue correctness labels are also manual. No manual phone/segment boundaries established.
available_primary_data: PxCorpus.zip (375.7 MB); WAV audio; paths.txt; metadata.txt; seq.in; seq.out; seq.label; PxSLU_conll.txt; events.txt; dialogue_annotations.txt; scripts
notes: 55 participants; record gives 903 sessions and 1981 recordings in tabulated totals, while prose also says 2067 recordings. Preserve discrepancy. High-value clinical/speech-science metadata and human-verified transcripts, but keep in review until database policy resolves whether utterance-level human-verified orthographic/semantic annotation without manual phonetic segmentation qualifies for core production ingest.
